|------------|--------------|-----------------------|

| **Baan Thai** | West Loop | Provides vegetarian options such as vegetable curry and tofu pad see ew. |
| **Siam Square** | West Loop | Has vegetarian-friendly dishes and a separate vegetarian menu. |

All of these restaurants are well‑rated and located in the West Loop area of Chicago. If you’d like more details (address, phone number, hours), just let me know!
